files: .agents/rules/整网测试收敛优化专项规则.md

semantics: observer-only remains the default and is byte-frozen
VCD is an explicit per-package opt-in using only package-local TB standard dump tasks
VPD, FSDB, UCLI direct-VCD and vendor signal-query paths remain forbidden
one package selects exactly one bulk evidence mode
family diagnosis authority remains with the family owner
VCD dump targets are the exact source-bound signal catalog; module-scope over-dump is forbidden
freeze supervision consumes appended VCD timestamps from an unsigned non-overflowing 64-bit-or-wider 16384-cycle heartbeat, never a display-only integer
inline and legal multiline VCD timescale declarations are accepted
partial, unflushed, unreaped or non-exact-set evidence cannot pass finalization
target claims require live same-attempt target-entry, downstream-state and first-error receipts
the outer runner consumes only the shared evaluator decision and may not duplicate plateau/freeze thresholds
first-fresh replay must prove advancing timestamps and suspected-only plateau continue, while full plateau and true freeze stop
the quiescent archived VCD SHA/bytes/last timestamp must exactly bind the final runtime timestamp
a family's first diagnostic VCD round binds an exact current-family round-three-or-later breadth receipt and a reasonable signal-count range as a soft reference, never a standalone count blocker
an out-of-range first round records relation, explanation and acknowledgement
every HIGH-probability candidate should bind a source-bound zero-hop direct driver leaf; a missing leaf is a visible record-only gap while the candidate matrix remains distinguishable
later rounds may adaptively remove signals with family-recorded reason, HIGH or MEDIUM confidence and affected candidates; LOW confidence retains the signal by default
per-signal proof covering every preserved candidate is not required for adaptive pruning
later rounds must bind exact predecessor add/remove/unchanged diffs, candidate preservation or closure, and unchanged source identity
breadth refinement never weakens the existing VCD size, plateau, freeze, flush, reap or return protections

claim_boundary: Semantic merge recommendation only; this file does not activate a public rule, mutate a package or authorize server execution.
